title.narrative: Upscaling UNESCO's efforts to the fight against racism & discrimination

description.narrative: UNESCO's Roadmap against Racism and Discrimination will continue to serve as the Organization's strategic framework for advancing action across all its fields of competence. Building on this foundation, UNESCO will leverage its normative mandate, standard-setting role, research capacities, convening power, advocacy reach and capacity-building expertise to address racism and discrimination at local, national, regional and global levels. UNESCO will strengthen the Global Forum against Racism and Discrimination as the world's only dedicated multistakeholder platform to drive policy dialogue, promote international cooperation, facilitate the exchange of good practices, and mobilize collective action. To translate dialogue into impact, UNESCO will expand its ecosystem of networks and partnerships through the Global Alliance against Racism and Discriminations, the Network of Anti-Racism and Anti-Discrimination Officials, the Master Class Series against Racism and Discrimination, and the Writers against Racism initiative. With the consolidated Sciences Sector, UNESCO will renew work on the scientific underpinnings of racism and discrimination, building on its historic leadership in challenging pseudoscientific theories of racial hierarchy. UNESCO will also leverage interdisciplinary expertise to strengthen links between anti-racism, gender-based discrimination, ableism, climate justice, environmental inequalities and emerging challenges such as bias in artificial intelligence systems. Recognizing that racism is rooted in historical and structural inequalities, the UNESCO Dialogues for Reparatory Justice will remain an important vehicle for tackling the root causes of racism and discrimination and promoting reflection on recognition, accountability, healing and repair. By acting across normative and standard-setting work, research and data, capacity-building, advocacy, coalition-building and public engagement, UNESCO will continue to strengthen its leadership within the global community and drive coordinated action toward more just, equitable, inclusive and resilient societies.
